notes.finding: The retained native emitter tip and release flash are yellow-green. An earlier internal blue-white description was imprecise and has been corrected.
notes.runtimeConsequence: Keep the small physical projectile feedback yellow-green to match the retained atlas. The measured aperture remains the actual integrated emitter tip; do not substitute a handheld staff or gun.

notes.finding: Independent visual review found elongated blue emission in preparation/recovery positions of the first energy revisions.
notes.resolution: Two image_gen corrections each supply twelve new source drawings: four finishing, four super, four ordinary. Only source/runtime column2 emits beyond the metal muzzle. No code repaint, invented charging behavior or afterglow justification is used.

notes.finding: An unnecessary local super column permutation moved the existing correct release pose into preparation.
notes.resolution: Independent review caught the timing mismatch. The permutation was removed, intact source drawings restored to their proper order, points remapped and the changed contact inspected again. The previous grid and measurement snapshot remain archived.

notes.finding: The image preview looked brown despite transparent background pixels. Actual RGBA samples showed alpha0 with hidden brown RGB in gutters.
notes.resolution: An already-requested alpha revision is archived alongside its original. One48-drawing selection counts. No background or alpha channel was painted by code.

notes.finding: Final root review found the Baratus native super contact pose empty-handed and Ranger contact pose back-facing with the held axe entirely invisible. Previous visual review had missed these defects.
notes.resolution: Two genuine image_gen strips each provide four distinct new native SUPER drawings with the complete physical axe held and visible in every pose. The original four SUPER drawings of each hero are excluded, never justified as throwing or a hidden weapon. Exact previous body calibration is pinned, all120 BASE16 PNG and their registries preserved, and28 non-super native cells per hero compared byte-for-byte.
